package.name: blueboat_harbour_population
package.description: Evidence-based population of harbour seabeds with litter, debris and structures (the "mission-like" object placement of the BlueBoat world builder): populate(environment, params, seed) -> PlacementPlan. Pure Python (numpy, scipy, PyYAML), no ROS and no Qt. It lives outside the blueboat_sss_sim package on purpose: its parameters are recalibrated without changing the simulator's code digest.
